relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, PGE2 promotes the secretion of IL-6, and in turn, IL-6 promotes the secretion of PGE2 by osteoblasts.

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: TNF-α directly induces osteoclast differentiation by activating NF-κB and c-Jun NH2-terminal protein kinase (JNK) in a RANKL-independent manner79

relationships.subject: bevacizumab
relationships.evidence_quote: bevacizumab (a VEGF blocking antibody) attenuated the formation of subchondral type H vessels in an OA model, thereby inhibiting chondrocyte hypertrophy and delaying OA progression.50

relationships.subject: calcium-phosphate complexes
relationships.evidence_quote: Cartilage also obtains calcium–phosphate complexes from subchondral bone, which increases the production of MMP-13 in chondrocytes via activation of nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-κB), p38 and ERK1/2, and signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) signalling.74

key_findings: Review: pathological osteoclast-chondrocyte crosstalk in the subchondral bone microenvironment drives OA progression.
Targeting type H vessel formation (e.g. VEGF blockade) and bone remodelling are proposed OA therapeutic strategies.
